title: Recent Transactions List Drops the Latest One
description:
`recent_transactions(transactions, n)` should return the last `n` transactions from the list, in their original order (most recent last). Right now the slice boundaries are off. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Function signature**
`recent_transactions(transactions: list, n: int) -> list`

**Example**
`recent_transactions(["a", "b", "c", "d"], 2)` -> `["c", "d"]`.
